newsitem.title: USA: Kansas City, Missouri eyes $100 million bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Kansas City, Missouri eyes $100 million bond issue.

text.p: Kansas City voters may be asked in April to approve a $100 million bond issue to expand the city's streetlight network, local government sources said Friday.
A subcommittee of the City Council this week recommended placing the streetlight issue on the April 1 ballot. The entire council was expected to vote on the recommendation January 16.
City Councilman Ed Ford, who headed the subcommittee, said the current streetlight system is a mishmash of lights owned by the city and by Kansas City Power and Light Co (KCPL).
Ford said the bond sale would allow the city to buy out KCPL's share in the system and upgrade the network by adding up to three times as many streetlights.
